newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues to boost balance sheet in mergers.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues to boost balance sheet in mergers.

text.p: French construction firm Bouygues plans to take over and merge three subsidiaries in a move which will strengthen its balance sheet by some 1.36 billion francs.
Bouygues gave notice on Friday in the Official Bulletin (BALO) of an extraordinary shareholders meeting on November 26, to approve the merger of CFTR, Minoterie Parisienne and Fremoulin.
The deals will boost Bouygues' balance sheet as the mergers will be done at net asset values higher than the current valuation on Bouygues' books.
